title: Custom CNC Jali Cutting Panels & Fretwork Dividers
description: Jali cutting is an architectural technique of machining open, decorative patterns completely through rigid panels. It allows natural light and air to circulate freely while acting as an elegant, breathable partition between spaces.
design_scope: Organic radiating leaf petal and floral motifs
Modern geometric, parametric, and Moroccan grids
where_to_use: Pooja room backdrops, partitions, and doors
False ceiling decorative panels and ambient light cutouts
Staircase railing screens and balcony facades

title: Custom V-Carved Signage & Precision Engraving
description: V-carving utilizes specialized angled router bits to cut varying depths into solid panels, producing crisp, three-dimensional lettering and sharp vector graphics. This technique delivers high-contrast, premium branding that flat, traditional printing cannot replicate.
design_scope: Corporate logos and embossed brand crests
Traditional serif and modern sans-serif typography
Intricate vector linework and botanical illustrations
where_to_use: Corporate office reception backdrops and branding walls
Wayfinding and directional plaques for hotels or commercial spaces

title: Precision Profile Cutting & Architectural Inlays
description: Profile cutting involves machining exact 2D perimeter shapes and structural components, while inlaying creates shallow, precise pockets to seamlessly embed contrasting materials (like acrylic or metal) flush into the primary board.
design_scope: Bespoke furniture components and contoured table tops
Flush-mounted logo inlays (e.g., Acrylic embedded into Wood/HDHMR)
Custom archways, door frames, and architectural trim

title: Custom 3D Bas-Relief Murals & Sculptural Panels
description: Bas-relief carving brings flat walls into dimensional life. Our 3D CNC routing machines sculpt continuous, varying depths into solid boards, creating elegant shadow lines, highly detailed textures, and architectural warmth.
design_scope: Narrative storytelling and religious iconography (Mandir backgrounds)

tech_specs.materials: HDHMR, Teak, Mahogany, Solid Wood, WPC
tech_specs.finishes: Raw machine-cut, PU white primer-coated, or clear-coated natural wood

title: Custom Parametric Walls & Acoustic Waffle Structures
description: Parametric design uses algorithmic patterns to create flowing, undulating 3D surfaces. This is achieved by precision-cutting dozens of uniquely shaped 2D ribs that, when assembled on-site, form a continuous sculptural wave.

tech_specs.finishes: Raw sanded, PU white primer-coated, or polished natural wood grain

customization: Scalable to massive architectural spaces. Provide your basic wall dimensions and a reference image to begin parametric modeling.

title: Custom Textured, Fluted & Wave Wall Panels
description: Architectural wall claddings engineered to transform flat interior drywall into premium textured surfaces. Our machines carve repeating geometric and organic patterns directly into the board's face to create continuous rhythm.
design_scope: Modern ribbed slats and fluted grooves
where_to_use: Living room TV and media unit backings

tech_specs.finishes: Raw CNC sanded, Primer-coated for site painters, or Factory PU spray

customization: Designed as modular panels with accurate joints and continuous pattern matching for seamless installation across entire walls.

title: Custom 3D Printed Deity Sculptures & Sacred Figurines
description: High-fidelity additive manufacturing of sacred icons and religious figurines. We utilize ultra-high-detail resin printing to capture micro-textures and complex jewelry details that are practically impossible to achieve with traditional clay casting.

tech_specs.finishes: Antique bronze patina, matte marble-white, or hand-painted acrylic

title: Custom 3D Portrait Busts & Lifelike Face Sculptures
description: Hyper-realistic 3D memorial busts and portrait sculptures engineered directly from standard 2D photographs. Our artists digitally sculpt the exact likeness before executing a flawless precision 3D print.

customization: Modeled entirely from your uploaded photos. Highly customizable poses, clothing, expressions, and integrated pedestal styles.

title: Complex Artistic Sculptures & Character Miniatures
description: Precision 3D printing designed specifically for dynamic, expressive art pieces. This technology allows for extreme undercuts, hollow internal geometries, and floating elements that cannot be machined on a CNC router.

tech_specs.thickness: Miniature desk scale up to medium gallery formats
tech_specs.finishes: Solid matte gallery white, gilded metallic leafing, or deep patinated bronze

customization: Fully custom digital sculpting covering pose dynamics, flowing drapery, complex props, and integrated base pedestals.
